title: Pancakeswap BNB to BUSD Yield Farming
description: Learn to use Pancakeswap BNB to BUSD yield farming.  You will learn how to become a liquidity provider on PancakeSwap and provide liquity to BNB BUSD pair.  Yield Farming in Farms is a great way to earn CAKE rewards on PancakeSwap. Farming pool require you to stake two tokens to get LP Tokens, which you then stake in the Farm to earn rewards. This lets you earn CAKE while still keeping a position in your other tokens! Yield farming takes a little work to get set up. You’re going to need some "LP Tokens" to enter into a Farm with. Farms can only accept their own exact LP Token. In my example, the BNB-BUSD Farm will only accept BNB- BUSD LP Tokens. To get the exact LP Token, you'll need to provide liquidity for that trading pair.   The ROI (return on Investment) on BUSD-BNB pair as follows: APR inluding LP rewards is 50.17%. Base APR (yield only) is 19.0%.  Normalized for CAKE rewards for $1000 is for 1 day time frame it is 0.05% ROI and with CAKE per $1000 is 0.04%. For 7 days ROI is 0.36% with CAKE per $1000 is 0.28%. For 30 days ROI is 1.57% and CAKE per $1000 is 1.22%. For 365 days or APY is 20.92 ROI and 16.28% for CAKE per $1000. LP rewards of 0.17% trading fees distributed proportionally to token staked among LP token holders.  BNB is binance exchange coin.   For this you need to have funds in your Metamask wallet connected to Binance Smart Chain.  You have to convert BNB to BEP20 token. I send BNB from Binance US exchange to Binance Chain Wallet as BEP2 and use Binance Chain Wallet and convert to BEP20.  I will provide link below on how to convert BNB to BEP20 BNB on Metamask wallet. I used BEP20 BNB on Metamask wallet to buy BUSD to swap BNB into BUSD. Then, I added liquidity to PancakeSwap BNB / BUSD pair.  Goto pancakeswa.finance/farms.  Select BUSD-BNB pair.  Click Get BUSD-BNP LP (LP short of liquid provider) pair.  In my example, I am adding 0.1 BNB and 28.5 BUSD. First, you need to click approving BUSD. This will be confirmed via Metamask wallet.  Metamask will send a confirmation to the transaction.  It shows in this example BUSD per BNB as 282.939 and BNB per BUSD at 0.00353 and share of Pool. My example is less than 0.01%.  You will get a transaction receipt as approved from Metamask wallet from BScScan. Now click Supply.  Now I got a message saying how much BNB/BUS Pool Tokens I am going to get.  I got 1.5136 BNB/BUSD pool tokens. Screen show following transaction rates. BNB deposited was 0.100738 and BUSD deposited was 28.5027. The conversion rate was 1BNB = 282.9 BUSD. My share of the pool is 0.00001931%.  Click Confirm Supply button.  Funds from you Metamask wallet will be used to pay for gas fees.  I kept the default gas price of 5 Gwei with gas limit of 232796.  The total fee was 0.10 USD.  This is why I like Binance Smart Chain because of the lowest gas fees compare to Uniswap with Ethereum based. Click Confirm.  In this I am supplying 0.100747 BNB and I will get only 0.100738 BNB tokens.  As you can see, there is a transaction submitted screen.  You can click close or click view on BscScan.  BscScan is similar to etherscan on Etheruem where you can see all of your transactions. I got a transaction confirmation pop up from metamask where 0.1 BNB and 28.5 BUSD was added to the liquidity pool successfully. I get LP token in your wallet summary that say I have 1.513 BNB-BUSD LP tokens with pooled BNB of 0.1000726 and Pooled BUSD of 28.505. On your Liquidity on Pancakeswap, you can see all your Liquidity pairs.  You can click down arrow of BNB/BUSD pair.  You can click Remove to remove liquidity from pancakeswap bnb to busd yield farming.  If you find this video usefuly do not forget to hit to subscribe and link buttons above.  Happy crypto yield farming on Pancakeswap. May Sathoshi be with you!  Pancakeswap Yield Farming: https://docs.pancakeswap.finance/products/yield-farming/how-to-use-farms  https://accounts.binance.us/en/register?ref=54224962 https://www.coinbase.com/join/gurusi_w Get $10 Coinbase Bitcoin when use this link.  If you enjoy our videos, I would be very happy if you decided to join our community by subscribing and commenting on our videos. Have a wonderful day or evening!  SUBSCRIBE: http://bit.ly/3ce2zva  Relevant hashtags: #yieldfarming, #Pancakeswap, #metamask, #cryptocurrency, #BNB

asr.full_text: In this video I will teach you on using CakeSwap BNB to bust YieldFarming. You will learn how to become a liquidity provider on PancakeSwap and provide liquidity to BNB BUSD pair. YieldFarming in farms is a great way to earn cake rewards on PancakeSwap. Farming pool require you to stake 2 tokens to get LP tokens, which you then stake in the farm to earn rewards. This lets you earned cake while still keeping a position in your other tokens. YieldFarming takes a position in your other tokens. Yield farming takes a little work to get set up. You're going to need some LP tokens to enter into a farm with. Farms can only accept their own exact LP token. In my example, the BNBB U.S.D. Farm will only accept BNBB U.S.D. LP tokens. To get the exact LP token, you'll need to provide liquidity for that trading pair. BNB is Binance Exchange coin. For this you need to have funds in your MetaMask wallet connected to Binance smart chain. You have to convert BNB to BIP20 token. I send BNB from Binance US exchange to Binance chain wallet as BIP2 and use Binance chain wallet and convert to BIP20. I will provide link below on how to convert BNB to BIP20 BNB on MetaMask wallet. I used BIP20 BNB on MetaMask wallet to buy BUSD to swap BNB into BUSD. Then, I added liquidity to Pancakes swap BNB, BUSD pair. Go to pancakeswa.finance/.farms. Select BUSD BNB pair. Click Get BUSD BNPLP, LP short of Liquid Provider, Pair. The ROI, Return on Investment, on BUSD BNB Pair as follows, APR including LP Rewards is 50.17%. Base APR, Yield Only, is 19.0%. Normalized for Cake Rewards for $1000 is for one day time frame it is 0.05 percent ROI and with cake per $1,000 is 0.04 percent. For seven days ROI is 0.36 percent with cake per $1,000 is 0.28 percent. For 30 days ROI is 1.57 percent and cake per $1,000 is 1.22%. For 365 days or APY is 20.92 ROI and 16.28% for CAKE per $1,000. LP rewards of 0.17% trading fees distributed proportionally to tokens staked among LP token holders. In my example, I am adding 0.1 BNB and 28.5 BUSD. First you need click approving BUSD. This will confirmed via MetaMask Wallet. MetaMask will send a confirmation transaction. It shows in this example BUSD per BNB is 282.939 and BNB per BUSD at 0.00353 and share of pool. My example is less than 0.01%. You will get a transaction receipt as approved from metamask wallet from Baeste Scan. Now click supply. Now I got a message saying how much BNB slash BUST pool tokens I am going to get. I got 1.5136 BNB slash was 0.100738 and BUSD deposited was 28.5027. The conversion rate was 1 BNB equals 282.9 BUSD. My Sheriff pool is 0.00001931%. Click Confirm Supply button. Funds from UMetamass wallet will be used to pay for gas fees. I kept the default gas price of 5 Gui with gas limit of 232,796. The total fee was 10 US cents. This is why I like Binance smart chain because of lowest gas fees compared to Uniswap with Ethereum based. Click confirm. In this I am supplying 0.100747 BNB and I will get only 0.100738 BNB tokens. As you can see there is a transaction submitted screen. You can click close or click view on Bayest's SayScan. Bayest's SayScan is similar to Etherscan on Etherium where you can see all of your transactions. I got a Transaction Confirmation poop up from MetaMask where 0.1 BNB and 28.5 BUSD was added to the liquidity pool successfully. I get LP token in your wallet summary that say I have 1.513 BNB BUSD LP tokens with pooled BNB of 0.100 0726 and pooled BUSD of 28.505. On your liquidity on pancakeswap, you can see all your liquidity pairs. You can click down arrow of BNB slash BUSD pair. You can click remove to remove liquidity from PancakeSwap BNB to BUSD yield farming. Have a good day, and I hope you'll take advantage of my good conditions! Happy crypto yield farming on PancakeSwap. May Satoshi be with you.
